justification: Both surfaces show a quadruped animal carved in profile facing right, but that is a near-universal motif; A presents a naturalistic narrative procession of human attendants leading horned rams beside a stylised tree above a rosette border, while B shows a single isolated, highly schematic beast with an arched back, angular zigzag legs and no accompanying figures, ground line or ornament. The manner of depiction is quite different — detailed fleece, musculature and facial features versus a flat outlined silhouette reduced to abstract angles — so the correspondence gives no sign of a shared iconographic scheme.
